# End-to-end bundle discovery differential (probe Temp/opencode/bundleprobe2, SDK 10.0.401).
# Reference: GameStructure.Load over a temp dir with two C#-constructed UnityFS
# bundles (ver 6, uncompressed, entries `main.assets` and `CAB-test`), each
# embedding the same C#-constructed gen12 SerializedFile (1 modern-tree type,
# 1 ClassID-1 object FileID 8001 with int 11 plus string "go", 0 externals).
# The reference materializes both entry namings without assemblies (Unknown
# scripting backend, TypeTree path) plus two injected engine collections.
# Format: BUNDLE_HEX|file-name|hex; REF|reference GameStructure dump line.
BUNDLE_HEX|bundle_assets.bundle|
BUNDLE_HEX|bundle_cab.bundle|
REF|STRUCT|valid=True|name=bundle_assets|mixed=MixedGameStructure
REF|COLL|cab-test|SerializedAssetCollection
REF|ASSET|1|8001|GameObject
REF|COLL|main.assets|SerializedAssetCollection
REF|ASSET|1|8001|GameObject
REF|COLL|unity default resources|InjectedEngineCollection
REF|COLL|unity_builtin_extra|InjectedEngineCollection
REF|COUNT|collections=4|assets=300
